notes.title: Random Dungeon Game Demo V0.4 is now Live
notes.notes:
Hey Dungeon Divers!
TRAPS are now in the dungeons!!! In Version 0.4 of Random Dungeon Game there are now dangerous traps to look out for along with more powerful enemies. The loot rooms and enemy rooms have also been improved adding path ways through them, so less dead ends! I hope you all enjoy this update as always all feedback is welcome!!! Post any feed back in the discussions on the community Hub,  cant wait to hear from everyone!

notes.title: Whats in the works
notes.notes:
Hello Dungeon Divers! 

 This announcement is to give you guys and gals some insight on what I've been and am currently working on deep in the dungeons lab. Ill start with the main feature, Traps! Yes that's right traps are coming into the dungeons, so watch your step, or  don't.... I wont put out any spoilers, but there will be a few different trap rooms added to the expanding mix of possible  rooms that will be spawned into the dungeons. Some traps are designed to end your adventure early, and some to add excitement and  more sense of adventure to the game, and could lead you... Ahg eem, Spoilers! ANYWAYS, next ill be talking about another smaller feature improvement that is much needed, MORE ENEMIES! Yes i know the dungeon does get a bit dull with the enemies that are in the current build. So im improving it by adding more, and some stronger ones too. Now with that in mind, id like to talk about another feature that im working on improving, Dead ends... The enemy rooms along with the loot rooms in the current build Version.03 are all dead ends, well im adding new enemy and loot rooms and redesigning others to not be dead ends. The idea behind this, especially with the enemy rooms is that now in some and hopefully most cases you will have to fight your way through in order to proceed through the dungeons, instead of just completely ignoring the enemies and just running straight to the portals.  What about after that? Well, if you had a chance to play Version.03 you would have noticed a new character selection system along with a Realm Selection system, so that will be next, adding a few more playable characters and building the dungeons for the Realm of Goblins. I hope you all have enjoyed the game thus far and will enjoy the upcoming changes! i give my deepest thanks for your support and interest in the game. Stay safe and see you in the dungeons!

notes.title: Random Dungeon Game Demo V0.3 is now Live
notes.notes:
Hey Dungeon Divers!
Random Dungeon Game Demo V0.3 is here! In this update I have added two new features, A character selection system and a realm selection system. I have also added a new playable character. There are no new realms to play yet, but there will be soon! I hope you all enjoy the new features!

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes:
Hey Dungeon Divers!
Random Dungeon  Game Demo has been updated, adding some new content and a few fixes. 

Added 1 new weapon for a total of 4 usable weapons.
Added 4 new rooms to spawn randomly in the level making the new count 40 rooms
Added some new visuals for the health bar and stamina bar
Added new visuals for the equipment menu for the equipped weapons/shield
Added new improved visuals for the portals 
Using "R" key to reset the level now resets the current level instead of respawning player in level 1

Fixed an issue where the player would spawn outside of the map at the start of new level
Fixed an issue where some rooms would spawn separate from others causing gaps making the player fall infinitely into the Void of No Return.
